item.title: Jewelry has a London Fashion Week moment amid gold and silver pricing concerns
item.description: London’s jewelry brands are turning precious metal volatility into stronger margins, urgency and bespoke growth.

item.title: 3 standout strategies driving Revlon’s 2026 comeback plan
item.description: Revlon is betting on bold color as it refocuses its brands in 2026 under CEO Michelle Peluso. That includes refreshes at Revlon, Almay, American Crew, Elizabeth Arden and Juicy Couture fragrances, among other brands. Glossy sat down with the executive 16 months into her tenure to learn about the tactics and strategies driving the brand’s turnaround effort.

item.title: Fashion brands are ‘cautiously optimistic’ about the Supreme Court striking down many of Trump’s tariffs
item.description: On Friday, the Supreme Court dealt a significant blow to the administration's efforts to enact sweeping tariffs on imports from nearly every country in the world. The Court's 6-3 ruling found that tariffs enacted under the International Emergency Economic Powers Act, which covers many but not all of the tariffs, were unlawful and that the president exceeded his authority.

item.title: Sephora Strategies: What MAC needs to succeed at Sephora
item.description: MAC has long since been available in international Sephora markets like Canada and the U.K. But with a new creative director in Nicola Formichetti, fresh talent like pop star Chappell Roan and a rebounding makeup category hungry for color, MAC has earned a place at Sephora's U.S. fleet. And with MAC's parent company The Estée Lauder Companies still finding its footing in makeup, a diversified retail presence at a global powerhouse like Sephora is as important as ever.

item.title: Off Season taps into the NBA’s growing merchandise sales with new licensed fashion collection
item.description: Off Season, the fashion brand founded by designer Kristin Juszczyk, has been primarily focused on the NFL through Juszczyk's connection — her husband is San Francisco 49ers fullback Kyle Juszczyk. But on Tuesday, Off Season idebuted its first NBA-centric ready-to-wear collection as it seeks to both expand its business and the types of products it makes with its team partners.

item.title: Rodan + Fields moves beyond social selling with influencer-powered ‘C-Suite’ campaign
item.description: To most consumers, Rodan + Fields is synonymous with social selling — or, as it is often called, multi-level marketing. In 2024, however, that began to change. The brand shifted to an omnichannel strategy, launching its own DTC site while maintaining its consultant network of more than 70,000 sellers. Exactly a year ago, it entered Ulta Beauty, marking its first major retail partnership.

item.title: Beauty Briefing: From nausea to relief, how beauty founders and execs are reacting to the Supreme Court’s tariff decision
item.description: This week, I checked in on how beauty founders and execs are responding to the whiplash of the Supreme Court’s ruling on Trump’s tariffs. Additionally, Brazil may be getting more K-beauty, and Saks secures a round of bankruptcy funding.

item.title: Wellness Briefing: Oura Ring launches female-focused LLM as demand for wellness personalization grows, plus news
item.description: This week, I checked in with Tanvi Jayaraman, MD, the leading physician behind Oura Ring’s new female-focused AI chatbot powered by a new, custom large language model. Made specifically for women’s health concerns, it’s a first-of-its-kind launch from the wearables company.

item.title: Can solid perfume be the next body mist?
item.description: Solid perfumes have long been on the market, with brands like Glossier and Diptyque offering solid versions of their traditional spray perfumes. But with fragrance sales still on the rise, a new wave of brands is experimenting with solid fragrances to appease customers looking for novelty and affordability in their fragrance options.

item.title: American Eagle’s next marketing move? Sponsoring Stagecoach
item.description: On the heels of its February 11 announcement naming rising country musician Ella Langley as its newest brand face, American Eagle is unveiling another big music move: It will serve as the exclusive apparel and denim sponsor of Stagecoach, the world’s largest country music festival.
